description: This file defines the Image model class for Opencart's admin tool module. The class provides a method to resize images, handle caching, and ensure image dimensions are adjusted or copied accordingly.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Model class for handling image resizing within the Opencart admin tool module.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a specified image file to given dimensions, creates a cached version if necessary, and returns the URL to the resized image.
